### [Understanding ChatGPT Work](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Aug/30/understanding-chatgpt-work/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-08-30

ChatGPT Work introduces a cloud environment with internet-enabled code execution, a persistent cross-session filesystem, headless Chrome browser capabilities, and granular GPT-5.6 model selection.

- ChatGPT Work Cloud includes an unblocked code execution environment capable of accessing external APIs, websites, and package managers, unlike standard ChatGPT Chat containers.
- Model configuration in Work Cloud offers GPT-5.6 Sol, Luna, and Terra variants across reasoning tiers up to Ultra, which delegates tasks to sub-agent sessions.
- The environment includes a persistent shared filesystem between user sessions, a headless Chrome browser, and the ability to publish ChatGPT Sites.
- ChatGPT Work operates as two distinct products: a cloud version (Work Cloud) and a local version (Work Local, formerly Codex) that accesses local files and runs desktop programs.

**Why it matters:** It upgrades ChatGPT from a conversational interface into an autonomous, connected cloud environment capable of persistent file storage, web automation, and network-enabled code execution.
